title: EF Alpha Races
pages: EF alpha races. The EverChanging EVERFLAME. An alpha version of the EverChanging EVERFLAME setup book, made only for race choosing at SECOND CHANCE campaign.

Mole-kins / Mole-Kin. Racial traits. Mole-kin Toughness: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level. Stonecunning: As a Bonus Action, gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense. The stone can be natural or worked. Uses equal to Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses on a Long Rest. Underground stone workers and smiths. See the original illustrated page for lore and exact typography.

Oryxians. Racial traits. Powerful Build: You have Advantage on any saving throw you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity. Horned people associated with the earth, nature, balance, honor, and survival. Traits continue on the next page.

Oryxians, continued. Relentless Endurance: When reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you cannot do so again until you finish a Long Rest. Horns: Natural melee weapons usable for unarmed strikes; a hit deals piercing damage equal to 1d6 + Strength modifier instead of the normal bludgeoning damage. Hammering Horns: Immediately after hitting a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on your turn, use a bonus action to attempt to shove the target with your horns. Target must be within 5 feet and no more than one size larger. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier, push it up to 10 feet away.

Drakaari. Drakaari Broods: Bhumiar — Physical; Ignisar — Fire; Lyrion — Cold; Bronti — Lightning. Draconic Ancestry: Lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. The selected kind affects Breath Weapon, Damage Resistance, and appearance, with the exclusion of Bhumiars as noted in the alpha. Damage Resistance: Resistance to the damage type determined by Draconic Ancestry. Darkvision: Dim light within 60 feet as bright light; darkness as dim light; colors in darkness appear as shades of gray. See the original page for lore about the Great Destruction Event. Traits continue on the next page.

Drakaari, continued. Breath Weapon: When taking the Attack action on your turn, replace one attack with an exhalation in a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide; choose the shape each time. Creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw, DC 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Failure: 1d10 damage of your Draconic Ancestry type; success: half. The alpha prints scaling at character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (5d10), and 17 (4d10), excluding Bhumiars. These unusual values are retained as printed, not corrected. Reactive Resistance (Bhumiars only): When taking bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, use your reaction to gain resistance to that instance. Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on a long rest. Bhumiar Armor (Bhumiars only): As a bonus action, gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn. Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on a long rest. Draconic Awakening: Cone increases to 30 feet or Line to 60 feet; save DC increases to 10 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus; damage dice increases by one. Once on each of your turns, deal 1d10 extra damage of your ancestry type to one target when dealing damage with an attack or spell. For Bhumiars, Bhumiar Armor grants temporary HP equal to 1d10 + Proficiency Bonus; Reactive Resistance also deals piercing damage to the attacker equal to 1d10 + Constitution modifier. The supplied alpha page does not state an acquisition level for Draconic Awakening.

Ashari. Two forms: Ashari of Destruction, Cindralis; Ashari of Rebirth, Emberon. Racial traits. Darkvision: Dim light within 60 feet as bright light; darkness as dim light; colors in darkness appear as shades of gray. Talons: Unarmed strikes can deal 1d6 + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of the normal bludgeoning damage. Transformation traits continue on the next page.

Ashari, continued. Rebirth / Emberon. Healing Hands: As an action, touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus. The creature regains hit points equal to the total. Once used, cannot use again until finishing a long rest. Celestial Revelation: At 3rd level, gain the revelation below. Thereafter use a bonus action to transform for 1 minute or until ending it as a bonus action; cannot transform again until finishing a long rest. Radiant Soul: Two luminous spectral wings; flying speed equal to walking speed; once on each of your turns, extra radiant damage to one target when dealing damage with an attack or spell, equal to proficiency bonus. Destruction / Cindralis. Celestial Revelation: At 3rd level, a bonus action transformation for 1 minute, ending early as a bonus action; recharge on long rest. Radiant Consumption: Searing light radiates from eyes and mouth. Flying speed equals walking speed. Shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for 10 additional feet. At the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet takes radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Once on each turn, extra radiant damage to one target when dealing damage with an attack or spell, equal to proficiency bonus.

Ondari. Racial traits. Emissary of the Sea: Communicate simple ideas to any Beast, Elemental, or Monstrosity with a swimming speed. It can understand your words, but you have no special ability to understand it in return. Amphibious: Breathe air and water. Guardian of the Depths: Resistance to cold damage. Swimming Speed: Walking speed is 30 feet; swimming speed equals walking speed. Lore describes ocean cities, sea stewardship, and control of water. See the illustrated original for full lore.

Thalirs / Thalir. Variations: Cognivis and Beast-Kin. Cognivis: Visually apparent naked thoughts; experience the world with openness, insight, and emotional intensity. Beast-Kin: Can transform into a single beast form tied to primal ancestry. See the next page for racial traits, shifting choices, and Cognivis telepathy.

Thalirs, continued. Shifting (Beast-Kin): As a bonus action, assume a more bestial appearance for 1 minute, until death, or until reverting as a bonus action. When shifting, gain temporary HP equal to 2 × proficiency bonus. Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on a long rest. Choose one additional benefit when selecting this race: Beasthide — gain 1d6 additional temporary HP and +1 AC while shifted. Longtooth — when shifting and as a bonus action on other shifted turns, make an unarmed strike with elongated fangs; 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage instead of normal bludgeoning. Swiftstride — while shifted, walking speed increases by 10 feet; move up to 10 feet as a reaction when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet, without provoking opportunity attacks. Wildhunt — while shifted, advantage on Wisdom checks; no creature within 30 feet can make an attack roll with advantage against you unless you are incapacitated. Darkvision: Dim light within 60 feet as bright light; darkness as dim light; only shades of gray in darkness. Mental Discipline (Cognivis): Resistance to psychic damage. Dual Mind: Advantage on all Wisdom saving throws. Mind Link: Speak telepathically to any creature you can see within a number of feet equal to 10 times your level. You need not share a language, but the creature must understand at least one language. While using this trait with a creature, use an action to let it speak telepathically with you for 1 hour or until ending this effect as an action. It must be able to see you and be within this range to use the ability. This can be given to only one creature at a time; giving it to another takes it away from the first.

Spryxi. Racial traits. Spryxi Ingenuity: Know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips. Spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 1, 5 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box. Choose a Prestidigitation effect for the device; it produces the effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch. Choose an option when creating the device if the effect has options. You may have three such devices at once. Each falls apart 8 hours after creation or when dismantled with a touch as a Utilize action. Lucky: When rolling a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, reroll the die and use the new result even if it is a 1. Brave: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Darkvision: Dim light within 60 feet as bright light; darkness as dim light; only shades of gray in darkness. Lore describes playful inventors blending mechanical ingenuity and arcane energy. See the illustrated original for full lore.
